Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A 24 year old man was talking to his 82 year old friend about how much politics has changed in just the last few decades. Though the 82 year old complained about how things were much better way back before all these changes, the 24 year old took a much more optimistic view and was overall happy with the politics of today. Who is resistant to change?
A. The 24 year old
B. Not enough info
C. The 82 year old
